faqs.q: What are the documents required to apply for BOBCARD Select and other BOBCARD Credit Cards?
faqs.a: The applicant must have proof of identity, address and income, along with a recent passport size photograph, while applying for BOBCARD Credit Cards.

faqs.q: Do I get accelerated rewards on all travel spends using BOBCARD Select?
faqs.a: No, cardholders can get extra rewards on flight and hotel bookings made using BOBCARD SmartDeal platform only. All other travel spends outside this platform will earn the base reward rate of 1 Reward point per Rs. 100 spent.

faqs.q: What is the capping limit on 5X rewards earnings using BOBCARD Select?
faqs.a: 5 reward points per Rs. 100 spent on online and dining spending categories have a combined capping of 1,000 reward points per month. After reaching this limit, these category spends would accrue 1 reward point per Rs. 100 spent.

faqs.q: Is there any cashback benefit on BOBCARD Select?
faqs.a: The reward points that you earn on the spends made using BOBCARD Select Credit card can be redeemed as cashback.

faqs.q: Is BOBCARD Select available for self-employed?
faqs.a: Yes, self-employed applicants between the age of 24 and 65 years and a net annual income of more than Rs. 4.8 lakh are eligible to get BOBCARD Select Credit Card, subject to other internal policies of the card provider.

faqs.question: What is the reward point value for BOBCARD Select?
faqs.answer: The reward points earned on the BOBCARD Select credit card are valued at ₹0.25 each. You can redeem these points for statement cashback at a 4:1 ratio.

faqs.question: How do I waive the annual fee on my BOBCARD Select card?
faqs.answer: The annual fee of ₹750 is waived if you spend ₹70,000 or more within a card anniversary year. Additionally, the joining fee is waived if you spend ₹7500 within the first 60 days of card issuance.

faqs.question: Is there a limit on the accelerated reward points?
faqs.answer: Yes, the 5X accelerated reward points on online shopping and dining are capped at 1000 points per billing cycle. Once you spend ₹20,000 in these categories, further spends will earn points at the base rate of 1 point per ₹100.

faqs.question: Does BOBCARD Select offer rewards on telecom bills?
faqs.answer: As of the April 1, 2026 update, spends on Telecom (MCC 4814) now earn core reward points. Standard utility bill payments generally do not earn reward points on this variant.

faqs.question: Are there any fees for paying education fees?
faqs.answer: Yes, a 1% fee (capped at ₹5000 per transaction) is applicable on education fee payments made via third-party apps like CRED, Paytm, or PhonePe as per the 2026 revised charges.
